scientific_integrity.main_result_scope: Exact standard synchronous propagation-time enumerator for all minimum forcing pairs on every singly chorded cycle with both arc lengths at least two.
scientific_integrity.proof_kind: Elementary exhaustive-in-parameter symbolic combinatorial argument; independent computational checks over finite ranges.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns standard simultaneous forcing from minimum-cardinality two-vertex sets on exactly one-chord cycles; it does not classify all larger minimal forcing sets or other forcing variants.
Finite simulations corroborate, but do not substitute for, the full parameterized graph-theoretic proof.
The relevant known zero-forcing-set identity is attributed to Boyer et al. (2018); the claimed contribution is the timing spectrum and extremal counts.
Historical priority is qualified pending independent literature review; independently certified novelty is not claimed.
title: Propagation-time spectra of singly chorded cycles
